name: Watch Order
description: Define viewing orders that mix films and episodes from different series, see what's missing from your library, and track each user's progress.
overview: Watch films and episodes from across a franchise in one defined order.

versions.changelog:
First public release.
- Watch orders that mix films, episodes, episode ranges and whole seasons from any number of series, matched to your library by TMDb, IMDb and TVDb ids (or title and year).
- A Watch Orders page in the web app, an "Up Next in Your Watch Orders" home screen row, and a "Part of a watch order" section on film, episode and series pages (these need the File Transformation plugin).
- Per-user progress from Jellyfin's own watched status, watch-throughs (count what you've seen, or start fresh), optional entries each user can skip, and autoplay that follows the order.
- A playlist of what's left in each order you follow, so any Jellyfin app can carry it on.
- A visual order builder, import from files, links or pasted JSON, and ready-made orders: the MCU, Star Wars, Cardcaptor Sakura and Urusei Yatsura (1981).
- Viewer stats for admins.
